objective: Test whether JANUS can discover a useful exact OBDD ordering package from opaque frozen CNF structure without family labels or semantic oracle access, while charging detection and structure-selection work and comparing against an oracle-best candidate order only for evaluation.
scope_boundary: R2C tests REPRESENTATION_DISCOVERY inside one exact language (OBDD). Cross-language switching remains R2D; cumulative switching remains R2E.

families: RENAMED_EQ_PAIR: conjunction of hidden variable-pair equivalences encoded as two 2-clauses per pair
RENAMED_XOR_PAIR: conjunction of hidden variable-pair inequalities encoded as two 2-clauses per pair
MATCHED_RANDOM_2CNF_CONTROL: same variable/clause counts, deterministic random non-tautological 2-CNF
frozen_corpus.variable_names: deterministically permuted integer ids; original pair ordering hidden from selector

candidate_structures.DEGREE_ORDER: ascending occurrence degree then variable id
candidate_structures.PAIR_GRAPH_ORDER: scan the opaque 2-CNF co-occurrence/signature graph; when a disjoint two-variable component is encoded by complementary clause-pairs, emit its variables adjacent; unmatched variables append deterministically

JANUS_selector.policy: If pair-signature detector certifies a complete disjoint pair decomposition covering all variables, choose PAIR_GRAPH_ORDER; otherwise choose DEGREE_ORDER. NUMERIC_ORDER is retained as baseline, not selector default.

oracle_evaluation: Compile the same CNF under every frozen candidate structure and take the smallest exact OBDD node count. Oracle-best never enters selector state.
cost_metric: C_discovered = detection_work + structure_selection_work + exact_OBDD_compile_nodes; compare against C_oracle_nodes for evaluation, while keeping detection cost explicit rather than erased.

gates.G1_NO_ORACLE_LEAKAGE: selector receives only CNF and deterministic namespace-independent code path
gates.G2_EXACT_SEMANTICS: all compiled OBDDs agree with CNF semantics on exhaustive truth assignments for m<=8 and via exact residual-CNF compiler identity thereafter
gates.G3_PAIR_DISCOVERY: 100% of RENAMED_EQ_PAIR and RENAMED_XOR_PAIR instances receive certified complete pair decomposition
gates.G4_CONTROL_SPECIFICITY: MATCHED_RANDOM_2CNF_CONTROL is not falsely certified as complete pair decomposition on more than 20% of controls
gates.G5_ORACLE_ORDER_MATCH: JANUS selected order has the same OBDD node count as oracle-best candidate on at least 90% of pair-family instances
gates.G6_PAID_REGRET: median (detection_work + selected_nodes) / oracle_best_nodes <= 1.50 on pair-family instances; this is finite accounting, not an asymptotic theorem
gates.G7_SCIENTIFIC_BOUNDARY: R2C cannot claim universal order discovery, cross-language portfolio success or P=NP

journal_rule: Append every detector decision, false positive/negative, oracle comparison, detection work, OBDD compile size, first regret outlier and post-result lesson. Do not rewrite R2AB negative result.
